title: First product iteration after the feedback on my last post
author: watchingtheedge
selftext:
The discussion on my last post gave me a much more concrete problem to work on.

One trader described how supposedly independent strategy modules can quietly become the same underlying USD/gold exposure. The useful alert isn’t just “correlation went up” — it’s more like:

**“These strategies were supposed to be independent, but several different signals now suggest they’re starting to share the same failure condition.”**

That exposed a limitation in the version I showed before.

So in this release I focused on the external-observation workflow:

* External Live is now a general interface for externally computed metrics, not tied to one broker/platform.
* An agent can inspect the capability, design the metric contract and prepare an inert monitor draft itself.
* Activation still requires explicit human approval.
* The MCP schema now exposes the preparation contract properly, with field-level validation instead of vague errors.
* Each metric has its own freshness window, and stale/missing data becomes `DATA_UNAVAILABLE`.
* Metric definitions and monitor methods are versioned/frozen, and the evidence behind alerts keeps source/receipt timing.

The clip is a small test of that release.

I give Claude a pretty casual request to watch for a portfolio becoming dangerously crowded. It turns that into a new monitor draft using concentration, execution stress and regime stress, requires all three to persist for three consecutive updates, handles stale observations, adds cooldown behaviour, and stops at `PREPARED` for me to approve.

Important boundary: ASNOMIC is **not** calculating those portfolio metrics from raw positions or fills. The trader’s own process still computes them. ASNOMIC’s role is to keep the approved monitoring method alive, preserve the evidence and alert when the agreed condition is actually satisfied.

It also has no ability to place, modify or close trades.

One thing I liked about this iteration: the first attempt actually failed because our MCP preparation schema was too ambiguous for Claude. We fixed the interface instead of changing the demo prompt, redeployed it, and reran essentially the same request.

Still early, and the thresholds in the demo are placeholders rather than calibrated risk levels.

**Private beta**

If anyone here wants to try the current beta on [asnomic.com](http://asnomic.com) , the invite code is:

`ai-trading`

I’d especially like feedback from people already doing manual portfolio/risk monitoring and willing to tell me where this still falls apart.

comments.author: watchingtheedge
comments.body:
For anyone who wants to try the beta, here’s the current Claude setup:

1. Go to [**asnomic.com**](http://asnomic.com) and join the private beta with invite code `ai-trading`.
2. Sign in with Google and finish the beta/account setup.
3. In Claude, go to **Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector**.
4. Use this MCP URL: [`https://asnomic.com/mcp`](https://asnomic.com/mcp)
5. For authentication choose **Sign in now** and **Use Claude’s published identity**. You shouldn’t need anything in Advanced settings.
6. Complete the Google/OAuth sign-in and enable ASNOMIC in a fresh Claude chat.
7. You can then ask something simple like: **“Inspect the ASNOMIC capabilities available to my account and tell me what you can do with them.”**

Agents can inspect and prepare monitoring setups, but anything that creates live monitoring authority still stops for **human approval in the ASNOMIC portal**.

If anyone hits a confusing setup step or Claude misunderstands the capability surface, please tell me — that feedback is useful too.
